fact: As of 4 September 2026 Algeria had enacted no binding AI statute and no public draft legal text implementing the national AI strategy, while Law 18-07 as amended by Law 25-11 of 24 July 2025 restricts decisions based solely on automated processing and the ANPDP supervises it.
title: Algeria: AI, scraping, privacy, cybersecurity, communications, content-moderation, age-gating, and reuse law
